document.abstract: Use of audio-visual equipment designed specifically for individual self-instruction should be more widespread. Available units generally cannot be adapted to changing requirements and may restrict the selection of the most suitable method of presentation. A versatile system of interconnecting modules accommodates various visual and audio media and provides for student response and other functions.
